expenditures.detail: delta 10.00 - THE FILER'S OWN TWO FIGURES DISAGREE. The p6 attachment's 6 rows sum to 1455.49 and equal the attachment's own printed 'Total Expenditures $1,455.49' (that gate fires exactly). But the printed Schedule B TOTAL on p5 and Summary Page line 2 Column A both read $1,445.49. Both figures re-read in high-dpi rotated crops and both are unambiguous: 1,455.49 on the attachment, 1,445.49 on the form. Neither was adjusted; stated is retained verbatim.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The printed schedule pages (p3 Schedule A, p5 Schedule B) carry an EMPTY 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' cell and only a TOTAL ($800.00 / $1,445.49), so there is no page-subtotal gate on them. The attachments carry no such label either but each prints its own column total: p4 'Total Contribution 800.00' (rows sum 800.00, GATE FIRES) and p6 'Total Expenditures $1,455.49' (rows sum 1455.49, GATE FIRES). The p6 gate fires against the attachment but NOT against the form's TOTAL - that is the 10.00 delta above.

Both attachments are stored ROTATED 90 degrees inside the PDF (poppler renders them portrait with the text running up the page); they were rotated clockwise to read, and the geometry percentages below are converted back to the portrait page as poppler renders it, so each row's band is a VERTICAL strip. Cover: YEAR-END January 31 box checked; NEITHER amendment box is ticked; typed form, signed 1/28/10, clerk-stamped JAN 29 2010. The filing is labelled a 2009 year-end but expenditure line 6 is dated 1/25/2010 - kept verbatim. PRIVACY: the p4 attachment prints full street addresses; they were discarded at read time and only city/state are recorded (row 3's street line is illegible/degraded anyway). The p2 Summary Page balance chain closes on its own terms: 1,080.85 + 800.00 = 1,880.85; 1,880.85 - 1,445.49 = 435.36 - i.e. the form is internally consistent around the 1,445.49 figure, and it is the ATTACHMENT that carries 1,455.49. A human may want to look at that 10.00.
